@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Ken had achieved financial a______y before he even graduated. He supports himself without help from his family.
= autonomy
~詞義 autonomy（n.）自主性
~原文 Ken had achieved financial autonomy before he even graduated. He supports himself without help from his family.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Even though the pencil case is old and worn, I still keep it for its s______l value.
= sentimental
~詞義 sentimental（adj.）情感上的
~原文 Even though the pencil case is old and worn, I still keep it for its sentimental value.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The mystery began to u______d as detectives uncovered new clues hidden among the victim's belongings; the murderer would be revealed soon.
= unfold
~詞義 unfold（v.）展現
~原文 The mystery began to unfold as detectives uncovered new clues hidden among the victim's belongings; the murderer would be revealed soon.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The graduates couldn't go on the graduation trip because the government had not a______zed it.
= authorized
~詞義 authorize（v.）授權;許可
~原文 The graduates couldn't go on the graduation trip because the government had not authorized it.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Having t______l knowledge and having practical experience are two very different things.
= theoretical
~詞義 theoretical（adj.）理論的
~原文 Having theoretical knowledge and having practical experience are two very different things.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Betty had surgery to remove the ______ in her breast. Thankfully, the surgery was very successful.
A: mentor
B: pitcher
C: server
D: tumor
= D
~詞義 tumor（n.）腫瘤
~原文 Betty had surgery to remove the tumor in her breast. Thankfully, the surgery was very successful.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Lowry arrived at the ______ point, but the taxi he had ordered was nowhere in sight.
A: cocaine
B: agenda
C: pickup
D: tuna
= C
~詞義 pickup（n.）接(人)
~原文 Lowry arrived at the pickup point, but the taxi he had ordered was nowhere in sight.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Scientists have come up with many ______ about how the universe was formed, but none of them have been proven yet.
A: pipelines
B: hypotheses
C: ideologies
D: shareholders
= B
~詞義 hypothesis（n.）假設
~原文 Scientists have come up with many hypotheses about how the universe was formed, but none of them have been proven yet.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The drug has passed ______ trials and is now ready for marketing.
A: adverse
B: clinical
C: explicit
D: sheer
= B
~詞義 clinical（adj.）臨床的
~原文 The drug has passed clinical trials and is now ready for marketing.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The two companies have decided to ______, which should give them an advantage over their other competitors.
A: cling
B: merge
C: shield
D: unlock
= B
~詞義 merge（v.）合併
~原文 The two companies have decided to merge, which should give them an advantage over their other competitors.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: shielding
B: thereby
C: clusters
D: coffins
E: fleeting
F: fluency

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Billy moved into an apartment right next to his office, ______ saving a lot of time on commuting.
= B
~詞義 thereby（adv.）因此
~原文 Billy moved into an apartment right next to his office, thereby saving a lot of time on commuting.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Rick has studied German for a few years, yet he still hasn't achieved his desired level of ______.
= F
~詞義 fluency（n.）流利
~原文 Rick has studied German for a few years, yet he still hasn't achieved his desired level of fluency.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Elly caught a(n) ______ glimpse of the shooting star before it disappeared behind the clouds.
= E
~詞義 fleeting（adj.）稍縱即逝的
~原文 Elly caught a(n) fleeting glimpse of the shooting star before it disappeared behind the clouds.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The thick trees acted as a barrier, ______ the tent from the harsh winter wind.
= A
~詞義 shield（v.）保護
~原文 The thick trees acted as a barrier, shielding the tent from the harsh winter wind.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The students were standing in ______ around the classroom, but they all went back to their desks when the teacher came in.
= C
~詞義 cluster（n.）群
~原文 The students were standing in clusters around the classroom, but they all went back to their desks when the teacher came in.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: metropolitan
B: bias
C: pirated
D: icon
E: eloquent
F: unprecedented

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: This year, there is a(n) ______ number of students applying for overseas exchange programs.
= F
~詞義 unprecedented（adj.）史無前例的
~原文 This year, there is a(n) unprecedented number of students applying for overseas exchange programs.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company strengthened copyright protections after discovering ______ versions of their products on the market.
= C
~詞義 pirate（v.）盜版的
~原文 The company strengthened copyright protections after discovering pirated versions of their products on the market.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The student representative gave a(n) ______ speech, and everyone stood up to applaud her.
= E
~詞義 eloquent（adj.）有說服力的
~原文 The student representative gave a(n) eloquent speech, and everyone stood up to applaud her.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: We should be objective and not let personal ______ affect our judgements.
= B
~詞義 bias（n.）偏見
~原文 We should be objective and not let personal bias affect our judgements.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The idol is a huge pop ______ in Asia. Many people have been inspired by her music.
= D
~詞義 icon（n.）偶像
~原文 The idol is a huge pop icon in Asia. Many people have been inspired by her music.
